name: f1600
role: Keccak-f[1600] permutation over 25 little-endian lanes at rdi, 24 rounds, round constants read from the rodata table

name: absorb
role: sponge write: xor input bytes into the rate part, permute through the f1600 slot at every full block

name: squeeze
role: sponge finalize-and-read on a copy: pad with delimiter and 0x80, permute, copy output blocks

name: ripemd160_compress
role: RIPEMD-160 block compression: five-word state at rdi, 64-byte block at rsi
